scope: Played missions M0–M6 and published between-session scenes through 27 October 2026. Character-specific knowledge indicated per note.

notes.text: Helped John and Prue through sponsored work and later professional recognition.
notes.source: Completed sponsor work; published M3 → M4 scenes

notes.text: Introduced John to Captain Nizar Ilman and put her own recommendation behind him.

Asha is the Breakwater duty officer through whom the crew handles sponsor assignments, references and work-related questions. Her support is an established relationship, not unrestricted permission to enter other factions' facilities.
notes.source: Breakwater sponsor contact; published work history

notes.text: Co-signed the accepted Dead Air closeout with Asha Raman.
Hiroshi is a senior Breathworks technical decision-maker associated with the Lungworks and environmental control. He signed off on the Dead Air closeout in that capacity.
Was taken to medical after Dead Air. Prue later met her back on field work, repairing a diagnostic unit while waiting for parts.
notes.source: M1 aftermath; Between sessions · M2 → M3

notes.text: Says the emergency requisitions and field modifications from Dead Air still need explaining afterward.
notes.source: Kezi's account · Between sessions · M2 → M3

notes.text: Kezi works on Breathworks field equipment and service systems. Prue knows her through Dead Air's aftermath and a later encounter at a repair job.
Was injured in the loading-bay accident investigated during Witness Window.
Prue visited her at Saint Orra. Vera wanted the final account to describe the equipment, load data and working conditions—not blame one worker for everything.
Was injured in the Witness Window accident and later admitted involvement in the decision to continue working.
Prue visited Quinn during a medically supervised period of confused wakefulness. Pella would not treat their uncertainty then as consent to an irreversible procedure.

entries.name: Jett
entries.role: Breakwater floor worker and loading-bay witness

notes.text: Was a worker and witness in the loading-bay accident investigation.
Jett later raised concerns with John about work being done before faults were entered in inspection records. At the time of the conversation he had not made a formal complaint.
During Hand-Off 1, the crew sent Jett a copy of controller AT-4726's operating records. Receiving those records does not establish an outcome for his equipment-dispute concerns.
Was the shift operations supervisor encountered during the Witness Window investigation.

entries.name: Opal Coil
entries.role: Dock Labor organizer and worker advocate

notes.text: Requested the crew's involvement in Witness Window and supported the final assessment.
Describes improved stop-work protection and scrutiny of unsafe equipment, while staffing and expensive problems remain unresolved.
notes.source: Opal's account · Between sessions · M2 → M3

notes.text: Has helped John bring loading workers together for informal discussions about leading a crew.
Talked with Prue about balancing debt repayment against making everyday life bearable.
Opal's conversations with John focus on how loading crews can speak up about supervisors and unsafe decisions without pretending he has been formally appointed their representative.
Accepted the Witness Window evidence package but questioned the crew's impartiality in future Claims investigations.
Told John that Claims cannot order a general search for the surviving M5 attackers and invited further relevant evidence.
Rejected John's ownership claim to the Marrowell shuttle. His notice permits resubmission with new evidence or a separate legal basis.

An examiner at Claims: he reviews documentary evidence and the limits of a claimant's authority. The crew can bring him new supporting material; a previous rejection is not a grant of the requested property.
notes.source: M2 · Witness Window; M5 shuttle determination

notes.text: Survived the Saint Orra surgery emergency after John and Prue stopped the dangerous recovery behavior.
Says her records-correction packet has been sent for external review. A reply has not been established.
Met John in a Breakwater administrative queue and later invited him to spend time in a hydroponic bay.
Blythe and John have an emerging personal friendship built through visits and conversations. Her outstanding external records problem remains separate from their relationship.
Prue spoke with her during visits to Vera and Quinn. She protects patients' confidentiality and medical consent.
Agreed to pass Prue's message to Levent and directed her to the Order of the Last Watch.
Forwarded Levent's reply nine days later. She has not offered Prue access to his confidential treatment information.
Pella is a Saint Orra clinician and a contact Prue has spoken with outside emergency treatment. She treats patient consent and confidentiality as firm boundaries.
Met John through Asha during an equipment handoff for his salvage tender.
Taught John's Zero-G practical sessions, including the final untethered exercise outside the Hub.
Nizar operates a salvage tender and supervised practical Zero-G instruction, assessing John's ability to handle real external conditions rather than awarding independent vessel privileges.
notes.source: Published Zero-G training and salvage scenes

notes.text: Trains Prue in Computers in exchange for community-selected supplies. The supplies were delivered over several trips.
Worked with the crew during Bonded Freight Security.
Assigned Prue a later practical exam: work out whether her field router can be upgraded and reprogrammed into a jammer, then test it.
Luca uses hands-on troubleshooting and practical exercises for Prue's Computers training. The field router currently supports isolated simulation, not live jamming.
notes.source: Published post-M6 scene; existing training record

notes.text: Offered John firearms training with range work reducing the price, including occasional longer commitments.
Worked with the crew on the M-17 processor incident and awarded a discretionary bonus after the mission.
notes.source: M4 · The Ore That Waits for Jump

notes.text: Consulted during the M-17 incident, assessed the geological evidence and recommended specialist escalation when necessary.
notes.source: M4 · The Ore That Waits for Jump

entries.name: Mireya Solano
entries.role: Hiring representative for the M5 pharmaceutical job

notes.text: Hired the crew for Bonded Freight Security and received the hardened archive module at closeout.
The archive's signed root index described concealed trials, suppressed adverse events and falsified records. Prue read the index; the detailed bundles remained encrypted.

Mireya was the named point of contact for the crew's pharmaceutical security contract and archive handoff. Her responsibility for that job does not establish broad authority over every IntelliRX department.

entries.name: Levent Arslan
entries.role: Leader of the M5 attacking group

notes.text: Led the opposing group during Bonded Freight Security and survived the confrontation.
Replied to Prue through Pella asking for his SMG, revolver and the equipment taken from his people.
His reply included no address or meeting arrangement. Whether he is willing to meet remains unresolved.
The crew dealt with him as the leader of an organized armed team during M5. Knowing that he survived does not establish where his team is now or what orders they have.
notes.source: M5 actual outcome and known uncertainty

entries.name: Cormac Trent
entries.role: Helix Meridian Corporate Field Operations · CERA-6 mission coordinator

notes.text: Coordinated John and Prue's CERA-6 assignment aboard CSV Hecate on behalf of Helix Meridian Corporate Field Operations.
notes.source: M0 · CERA-6 assignment and field contracts

notes.text: Was the named mission coordinator for the Caligo recovery operation and issued the crew's return-transit instructions.
notes.source: M0 · CERA-6 mission completion and return-transit record

notes.text: Recovered John and Prue's pods, provided their initial housing and sponsorship, and arranged their early Hub work.
Operates the bonded freight annex involved in M5.

Breakwater handles salvage, industrial recovery, repairs and contractor placement. Its support can include work orders, tools, housing and sponsorship, but it does not grant blanket authority at other institutions.
notes.source: Hub institutional overview; established work rules

notes.text: John and Prue's Cross-District Work Eligibility is recognized beyond Breakwater, but access to a particular site, employer or controlled area still depends on that site.
notes.source: Recognized work credentials; Hub access rules

notes.text: Treated injured workers and was the site of Blythe's surgery emergency.
notes.source: M2 aftermath; M3 · The Patient in Reserve

notes.text: Pella works here. Prue has visited Vera and Quinn here.

Saint Orra Hospital is the Hub's principal medically neutral hospital, providing surgery, trauma treatment, diagnostics, rehabilitation and prosthetic care. Local clinics and worksites still provide first-line treatment.
Medical decisions, informed consent and patient confidentiality remain the hospital's responsibility, not a patient's employer, sponsor or creditors.
Received the Witness Window evidence through Tovan Rusk.
Its written determination rejects John's present shuttle ownership claim while permitting a revised submission.

Claims records recovery debts, property claims, title, liens, custody arrangements and evidence submitted in disputes. Owning a vehicle and being allowed to enter, move or repair it are different questions.
Claims findings are separate from commercial registration at Ledger Quay and from Hub civil identity decisions at Central Records.
Paid John and Prue contractor compensation following their M4 work.
A major industrial employer managing extraction, mines, industrial muster, ore processing and heavy fabrication. Exploration and recovery assignments can involve old workings as well as active sites.
John and Prue have worked industrial recovery jobs in Deepwell-associated operations. Their completed work does not give them unrestricted access to mines or equipment.
The employer represented by Mireya Solano for Bonded Freight Security.

IntelliRX hired the crew through Mireya Solano for the M5 pharmaceutical archive security assignment. The contract gave the crew specific duties, not general access to corporate information or facilities.

entries.name: Marrowell
entries.role: Name associated with the M5 shuttle

notes.text: John's Claims correspondence identifies the contested craft as the Marrowell shuttle and states that an identifiable owner exists.
John has not been awarded ownership of the shuttle.
Permitted Prue to join a watch rotation beside the five deceased M5 attackers after Pella directed her there.
The Order maintains a watch for the deceased. Prue helped reconcile its volunteer relay against the paper roster during a later personal favor; that work did not create a new paid position.
notes.source: Between sessions · M5–M6; M6 · Open Channel, Closed Door

notes.text: Luca provided a list of practical supplies for the community, and Prue delivered them over several trips.
John has checked in, spoken with residents and learned about their previous work.
The supply arrangement with Luca was chosen around residents' practical needs, not a general equipment budget for Prue. The community and Computers training are related but remain distinct.
An independent range used by security crews from across the Hub. Márk Varga sent John a training offer from here.
Márk's offer pairs structured firearms training with practical range work; it is a training offer, not an already completed course or new license.

entries.name: Breathworks Compact
entries.role: Known through Dead Air medical support

notes.text: Covered the 500cr sponsor-grade fracture-care charge for John's Dead Air injury.

A major Hub institution responsible for atmosphere, pressure, ventilation, sealing and designated water-reclamation systems. Its technicians assess whether old and modified systems are safe to keep in service.
Breathworks certifications and inspections cover systems within its own mandate, not a general right to shut down another faction's operations.
John and Prue served as Helix Meridian specialists aboard CSV Hecate during the Caligo response.
Their old employment records were later received and reviewed for professional recognition on the Hub.

entries.name: Ledger Quay Consortium
entries.role: Commercial records, settlement and freight services

notes.text: A major faction handling commercial registration, contracts, escrow, accounts, trade records and carrier services. Its records make local business dealings recognizable to other parties.
Commercial recognition is not the same as a Claims title ruling or a Central Records civil identity determination. A stored or registered asset can still be subject to custody restrictions.
An informal federation of resident and neighborhood groups. Volunteers coordinate mutual aid, household support, staple-food help and advocacy for residents facing access or ration problems.
Cistern works closely with care providers and residents, but does not run Saint Orra Hospital or the Hub's technical water systems.
Its members have supported small-scale local growing and other practical community work, including assistance Cassidy provided in a shared growing area.

entries.name: Dock Labor Assembly
entries.role: Freight workers, rigging and workplace safety

notes.text: A formal labor institution associated with rigging, freight handling, safety stoppages, worker liens and job qualifications. Dock work orders do not by themselves waive handling or safety requirements.
Opal Coil is an established worker contact. John and Prue's loading-bay investigation and subsequent discussions with workers brought them into contact with dock labor concerns.
notes.source: M2 · Witness Window; published M3–M5 scenes

notes.text: A decentralized trade network associated with discreet carriage, difficult imports and unregistered or informal transactions. People dealing through an intermediary do not necessarily know an entire route.
A particular shipment or intermediary's full origin, destination and purpose cannot be assumed from the Blackline name alone.

entries.name: Bonded Freight / Bonded Freight Brokers
entries.role: Documented cargo custody and freight brokerage

notes.text: Bonded Freight is an organized arrangement for recordable cargo custody and handoffs involving Claims procedures and qualified dock labor. Bonded Freight Brokers are the public-facing brokers working through that arrangement.
A broker's commercial role does not make them the final authority on disputed title, safety qualifications or every carrier's access.

entries.name: Central Records
entries.role: Hub-local civil identity and status records

notes.text: Central Records handles Hub-local identity and living/deceased status. It does not make claims decisions for property or act as Ledger Quay's commercial registry.
A Hub-local record and an off-Hub corporate or ship-carried record can differ. Correcting one does not automatically update the other.
notes.source: M3 · The Patient in Reserve; Hub records limits

notes.text: A Cistern neighborhood liaison involved in the Dead Air community response. Her role is to represent local residents' concerns, not to command Breakwater work crews or Breathworks technicians.

entries.name: Talvi Venn
entries.role: Bonded freight broker · Ledger Quay Consortium

notes.text: Talvi Venn is a bonded-freight broker associated with Ledger Quay Consortium. Her work concerns commercial transfers and arrangements involving cargo, guarantees and brokers.
notes.source: Published player-facing institutional role · 2237-300; no crew encounter established

notes.text: Commercial brokerage does not let her decide disputed property title or bypass dock handling and custody requirements.
Risto Vero works at the Receiving Gallery's public receiving desk, where people bring questions about freight reception and transfer procedures.
notes.source: Published player-facing institutional role · 2237-300; no crew encounter established

notes.text: The receiving desk can help direct inquiries about transfers and cargo-tug procedures, but cannot independently grant access to restricted cargo.
notes.source: Public receiving-service role and custody boundaries

notes.text: Liora Mott is a public-side berth liaison in the Arrivals Concourse, helping visitors and crews navigate berth information and public arrival procedures.
notes.source: Published player-facing institutional role · 2237-300; no crew encounter established

notes.text: A berth liaison can explain visitor procedures and direct messages, but cannot grant boarding access without the required authorization.
notes.source: Public berth-service role and access boundaries
